set.title: Settings
set.enabledHint: When off, automatic sweeps stop; manual actions on this page still work.
set.dryRunHint: When on, a sweep only writes logs and stats and touches no files.
set.curveHint: Ebbinghaus: strength decays by half-life, each mention multiplies strength by growth, forgotten only below the survival floor. Additive: TTL = base × growth^n. Custom: your own expression computes the days.
set.curveExprHint: Variables: touches (mention count), base (base TTL / half-life, days), growth (growth factor), floor (survival floor). Math helpers log/ln/exp/sqrt/pow/abs/min/max/log10/log2/ceil/round and constants e/PI are available. Returns days, e.g. base + log(touches + 1) * growth (note log(1)=0, so a pure-log formula expires immediately at 0 mentions).
set.curveExprBad: This expression yields no valid days; it falls back to the Ebbinghaus curve when saved
set.maxOffWarn: With the cap off, TTL = base × growth^n grows quickly with mentions and can become extremely long.
set.onExpiryCold: Move to cold archive (manual restore only)
set.onTurnEnd: Also check at the end of each turn
set.sourcesEmpty: No memory source detected. Install a memory plugin and refresh.
set.evolveWarn: These two tracks are logs written every turn: they grow fast, and clearing them loses debugging clues.
set.standaloneHint: With no other memory plugin installed, write memories into this file and Memory Tide sweeps it on the same curve.
set.standalonePathHint: Empty = default (memory-tide/MEMORY.md under the DSH memory directory)
set.standaloneDelimiterHint: blank = split on blank lines; or type \n§\n
set.customEmpty: No custom adapters yet. Use the form below to bring any Markdown / JSON memory file under management.
set.label: Name
fmt.delimiterHint: Leave empty to split on blank lines; you can also type \n§\n literally.
set.discoveryHint: Scans Markdown / JSON memory files under ~/.dsh; adopt what it finds with one click.
set.mergeHint: Merge near-duplicate memories inside one source, file and track. Local comparison only, no model call.
set.mergeCost: Preview is free: merging is local, 0 tokens.
confirm.merge: Merge these {n} group(s)? Source files are rewritten and duplicates removed (backups are kept, but not archived).
confirm.mergeAll: No preview yet. Scan and merge all duplicates now?
